overview.description: The Amplify Top 10 Robotics ETF (ROBX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund targets 10 robotics companies from around the world. The actively managed fund directly invests in equity securities or through derivatives that provide exposure to companies from a reference index that employs fundamental, research-driven analysis of business activities. ROBX was launched on Aug 18, 2026 and is issued by Amplify Investments.
